contract: A road user moves against the designated direction of a travel carrier at the observation. It holds where the road user is moving (drv.motion.moving with speed_floor) and the component of its velocity along the carrier's designated direction is below minus opposed_cosine times its speed: the angle between its velocity and that direction is wider than the angle whose cosine is minus opposed_cosine. Velocity (kin.velocity) and speed (kin.speed) are in m/s in the world frame; the designated direction (st.lane_direction) is read normalised and is unknown where the carrier carries none. Crossing the carrier, or any motion at a smaller angle to the designated direction than that, is not against it. Not denoted: the road user's heading opposing the carrier (a body backing along a lane faces against it but moves with it), two road users being oncoming, or the road user being on the carrier: the caller states occupancy.

params.name: speed_floor
params.meaning: the source's speed resolution: a road user at or below it has no direction of travel

params.name: opposed_cosine
params.meaning: minus the cosine of the narrowest angle between the velocity and the designated direction that counts as against it

elements.span: the road user is moving (drv.motion.moving with speed_floor)
elements.justification: drv.motion.moving, co-proposed: speed above the source's resolution.

elements.span: Velocity (kin.velocity) and speed (kin.speed) are in m/s in the world frame
elements.justification: kin.velocity is the 'velocity vector' (m/s, world frame) and kin.speed its magnitude; the velocity, not kin.heading, is read, so a backing body is judged by its motion.

elements.span: the designated direction (st.lane_direction) is read normalised and is unknown where the carrier carries none
elements.justification: st.lane_direction is the 'direction of travel designated for a structure a vehicle travels in — a lane, ... or a roadway, one-way roadway or shoulder', read normalised; 'a place no carrier covers has none (unknown)'.

scenarios.name: holds
scenarios.narrative: A car drives along a one-way roadway opposite to its designated direction.

scenarios.name: fails
scenarios.narrative: A car drives along the same roadway in its designated direction.

scenarios.name: blind
scenarios.narrative: A car drives along a roadway; the source declares st.lane_direction absent.
